title: Points and camera column
description: A graphic panel and a camera column: two to four points light up one by one on one side while the speaker stays on screen in a tall rounded column on the other, framed on the face. On a slide each click shows the next point; on a phone the picture goes on top.

props.title: heading
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture
props.side: left = camera column on the left (default right)
props.click: false = no click steps on a slide
props.poster: still shown before the video loads
